thread:
ashley: FYI noticed a regression after the driver bump on the canary fleet (driver 56112). Short sequences (<64) on GA100/A100 path are hitting a 18-25% tail latency bump.
ranjit: ugh. is this kernel selection flipping to a slower path?
ashley: looks like it. autotuner moved some layers to the 'archsplit' vectorized kernel for hopper-optimized codegen, but on A100 that path is slower for tiny seqs. profiler shows extra kernel launches and smaller warps.
marta: can you paste the perf snippet? curious about occupancy vs launch overhead.
ashley: pasted below from the pprof run on a bento canary instance:
```
profiles:
  - kernel: archsplit_vec_v2
    avg_ms: 0.12
    p95_ms: 2.3
    launches: 4800
  - kernel: shortseq_fused
    avg_ms: 0.08
    p95_ms: 1.2
    launches: 2200
extra: context-switches + small-warp inefficiency
```
kevin: so autotuner heuristic picked archsplit due to microbenchmarks on larger seqs; runtime chooses per-layer kernel by architecture+seqlen heatmap and that selection rule didn't account for host driver scheduling change.
ashley: yep. driver 56112 seems to alter scheduling such that small launch overhead matters more (queue reorder). We didn't see that in microbench because CI runs had different queueing patterns.
ranjit: action plan? rollback drivers or force kernel selector tweak?
marta: short-term: pin canary to previous driver (56089) for 24-48h while we triage. Medium: add a conservative tiebreaker in kernel selector for sequences <64 on A100 to prefer shortseq_fused until autotuner collects more samples. Long: update autotuner to include driver variant and queue-depth features.
kevin: we should also run a focused perf sweep: for seqs [8,16,32,64,128] on A100/Hopper with driver 56112 and 56089 and capture launches/latency/cpu-sched stats.
ashley: agreed. I'll open a perf job and attach results. For rollback, ops — can you pin canary to 56089 now? @canary-bot: request
canary-bot: deploy job queued -> rolling back driver on 6 canary hosts. ETA 8m. :gear:
ranjit: also add a runtime flag to disable archsplit for short sequences (flip via feature flag) so we can hot-toggle without driver rollbacks.
marta: good call. that mitigates impact while we update autotune. kevin can you own the selector change? requires unit tests vs microbench harness.
kevin: yes. I'll add the 'seqlen_tiebreaker' and a telemetry tag so autotuner knows why we changed default. PR target EOD.
ashley: thanks. ops please monitor p95 and request traces for any customer-facing errors. I'll post perf job here when available.
ranjit: once we have perf sweep, we'll decide whether to keep driver pinned, flip selector heuristics, or do a staged rollout of driver 56112 with selector changes.
marta: also inform SRE and support with a short blurb — they might see elevated p95 on some tenants.
ashley: drafting blurb now. TL;DR: canary only, regression in short-seq latency on A100 after driver 56112, rollback in progress, mitigation: selector tiebreaker coming.
kevin: PR link when ready -> I'll attach perf graphs.
ashley: pinging later with perf results. thanks everyone. :pray:
